Content.LocalizedString: I've been researching contemporary youth lifestyles lately. Perhaps the Appraiser could offer some insights?

Content.SourceString: 年轻人的生活方式？
Content.LocalizedString: Youth lifestyles?

Content.SourceString: 是的，虽然哈尼娅和伊里卡有提供一些思路，但还是想听听鉴定师的看法。
Content.LocalizedString: Yes, though Haniel and Illica have provided some insights, I'd still like to hear your opinion.

Content.SourceString: 看漫画？《周刊Fantasy》似乎蛮受欢迎？
Content.LocalizedString: Reading manga? "Weekly Fantasy" seems pretty popular?

Content.SourceString: 漫展？
Content.LocalizedString: Comic conventions?

Content.SourceString: 呗果的一些版块里，大家都比较活跃，或许哈索尔可以尝试在里面找到自己心仪的版块。
Content.LocalizedString: Some of Bagel's boards are pretty active. Maybe you could try finding a section that interests you.

Content.SourceString: 漫展上会有各种动漫的周边，也会遇到很多同好，结交一些朋友。
Content.LocalizedString: Comic conventions have all kinds of anime merchandise, plus you'll meet lots of fellow fans and even maybe make some friends.

Content.SourceString: 我向来只是把呗果当成信息检索的手段，单纯的悠闲倒也是一种体验。
Content.LocalizedString: I've always just used Bagel as a means for info retrieval, but simply browsing for leisure could be an experience worth trying.

Content.SourceString: 调查了下，受众的确是以年轻人为主，或许我也要去定一些了。
Content.LocalizedString: I looked into it, and the audience is indeed mainly young people. Perhaps I should subscribe to some myself.

Content.SourceString: 听上去很有道理，海特洛的漫展内容，我会记录下来的。
Content.LocalizedString: That makes a lot of sense. I'll make sure to document the comic convention scene in Hethereau.

Content.LocalizedString: I've been documenting some tourist attractions around Hethereau lately…

Content.SourceString: 不知道鉴定师能否提供一些意见？
Content.LocalizedString: I was wondering if you could share some thoughts?

Content.SourceString: 旅游景点？哈索尔对于旅游很感兴趣吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Tourist attractions? Are you looking to travel?

Content.SourceString: 偶尔会在周围骑行，遇到顺眼的风景就记录下来，未来或许有用得着的地方。
Content.LocalizedString: I occasionally ride around the area, and when I come across nice scenery, I document it. Might come in handy someday.

OptionText.LocalizedString: People are interested in famous attractions…

Content.SourceString: 如果是受欢迎程度的话，大概人们都对一些比较知名的景点感兴趣？
Content.LocalizedString: If we're talking about popularity, I'd say most people are interested in well-known attractions, right?

Content.SourceString: 一些异象看上去似乎也很好看，或许也可以当作景点的一部分？
Content.LocalizedString: Some Anomalies actually look pretty impressive. Maybe they could be part of the attractions too?

Content.SourceString: 知名景点吗？上晴塔、噗卡乐园……呗果上已经有一些相关的情报了。
Content.LocalizedString: Famous attractions? Hethereau Skytower, Pukaland… there's already intel about those on Bagel.

Content.SourceString: 可能需要实际调研一番，如果异象本身具有较高危害性，即便外表再美，也不能忽视其潜在风险。
Content.LocalizedString: We'd probably need to do some actual fieldwork on that. If an Anomaly poses significant risks, we can't ignore the potential dangers… no matter how beautiful it looks.

Content.SourceString: 也许这些内容还值得进一步整理和拓展。
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe this content is worth organizing and expanding on further.

Content.SourceString: 感谢鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: I see, thank you.

Content.SourceString: 我已做好记录，等整理完成后会将这些内容一并发送给你。
Content.LocalizedString: I've made notes of everything. Once I finish organizing it all, I'll send the content over to you.

Content.SourceString: 情报免费。
Content.LocalizedString: The intel's free.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师对于海特洛的美食有了解吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you familiar with Hethereau's local cuisine?

Content.SourceString: 当然，我是海特洛的美食家。
Content.LocalizedString: Of course, I'm the Food King of Hethereau!

Content.SourceString: 略有了解。
Content.LocalizedString: I know a little.

Content.SourceString: 开心.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: happy.jpg

Content.SourceString: 在派送途中，我们通常会携带一些食物作日常补给，我主要以三明治为主。
Content.LocalizedString: During deliveries, we usually carry some food for daily sustenance. I mainly stick to sandwiches.

Content.SourceString: 除此以外，鉴定师能推荐一些适合配送时食用的食物吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Besides that, could you recommend some food that's suitable for eating during deliveries?

Content.SourceString: 牛肉干、黑巧克力、坚果混合包，还有小麦饼干，这些食品体积小，也是相对健康的食物来源，且方便携带。
Content.LocalizedString: Beef jerky, dark chocolate, mixed nuts, and wheat crackers. These foods are compact, relatively healthy, and easy to carry.

Content.SourceString: 能量饭团、便携便当之类的食物，有助于长时间的配送任务。
Content.LocalizedString: Energy rice balls, portable lunch boxes, and similar foods help sustain you through long deliveries.

Content.SourceString: 看来鉴定师对于食物也多有研究。
Content.LocalizedString: It seems the you know quite a bit about food as well.

Content.SourceString: 我记下了。
Content.LocalizedString: I've noted it down.

Content.LocalizedString: thanks.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师对于音乐有了解过吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you familiar with music?

Content.SourceString: 音乐？哈索尔是有什么事情吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Music? Is something going on with Hathor?

Content.SourceString: 最近和哈尼娅聊到如何提升配送效率的话题，她提到只要配送途中配上合适的BGM，效率会有明显提升。
Content.LocalizedString: I was talking with Haniel recently about improving delivery efficiency, and she mentioned that playing the right music during deliveries can significantly boost her performance.

Content.SourceString: 所以我想了解下，如果是为了提升配送效率，哪一类音乐会更为合适？
Content.LocalizedString: So I wanted to ask, what type of music would be most suitable for improving delivery efficiency?

Content.SourceString: 舒缓的音乐有助于放松，使大脑保持冷静，从而更高效地规划接下来的配送策略。
Content.LocalizedString: Soothing music helps you relax and keeps your mind calm, so you can plan your delivery routes more efficiently.

Content.SourceString: 激昂的音乐可以增强专注力，让人在配送途中保持清醒状态，或许更为合适。
Content.LocalizedString: Upbeat music can boost your focus and help you stay alert during deliveries, so it may be more suitable.

Content.SourceString: 思考.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: thinking.jpg

Content.SourceString: 感谢鉴定师的意见。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you for your advice.

Content.SourceString: 我会搜集下相关音乐，方便下次配送时根据环境做出调整。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll gather some relevant music so I can adjust based on the environment during my next deliveries.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，我最近在整理轻度疲劳的应对策略，你有什么推荐吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I've been organizing strategies for dealing with mild fatigue lately. Do you have any recommendations?

Content.SourceString: 恢复精力倒不是一件难事。
Content.LocalizedString: Recovering your energy isn't really that hard.

Content.SourceString: 让我想想……
Content.LocalizedString: Let me see…

Content.SourceString: 思考.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: thinking.jpg

Content.SourceString: 期待.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: excited.jpg

Content.SourceString: 如果是因为体力消耗产生的疲惫，短暂冷敷或饮用运动饮料，都能在一定程度上有所缓解。
Content.LocalizedString: If the fatigue is physical, a brief cold compress or drinking sports beverages can provide some relief.

Content.SourceString: 如果是精神疲惫，听些不同风格的音乐，再闭目休息一段时间，或许会有所缓解。
Content.LocalizedString: If the fatigue is mental, listening to different styles of music and then resting with your eyes closed for a period might help provide some relief.

Content.SourceString: 思考.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: thinking.jpg

Content.SourceString: 思考.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: thinking.jpg

Content.SourceString: 这个方法适合短时间恢复。看来，后续的体力调配也需要纳入策略方案中加以应对中。
Content.LocalizedString: This method works well for short-term recovery. It seems I'll need to include stamina allocation in my strategic planning going forward.

Content.SourceString: 音乐方面我会选择纯音乐，养神的前提是确保工作节奏不被打断。使用环境也需要一并纳入策略应对中。
Content.LocalizedString: For music, I'd go with instrumental pieces. The key to restoring mental energy is ensuring work rhythm isn't disrupted. The environment where this is used also needs to be factored into the strategic approach.

Content.SourceString: 看来鉴定师对于「适当放松」很有心得体会。
Content.LocalizedString: It seems that you have quite a bit of experience with relaxing.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，你有时间吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you have a moment?

Content.SourceString: 怎么了？哈索尔小姐是有什么事吗？
Content.LocalizedString: What happened? Is there something you need?

Content.SourceString: 上次替换邀请函的事情不知鉴定师是否记得？
Content.LocalizedString: I was wondering if you remember the incident last time? When the invitation was swapped.

Content.SourceString: 哈索尔小姐骑着机车过来，我记得这件事。
Content.LocalizedString: I remember you riding over on your motorcycle.

Content.SourceString: 让我想想，是追逐西汀替换邀请函的事吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Let me think, are you talking about chasing Settyn to replace the invitation?

Content.SourceString: 嗯。
Content.LocalizedString: Mhm.

Content.SourceString: 是的。
Content.LocalizedString: Yes.

Content.SourceString: 回去复盘后，感觉速度还有提升空间，可能是零件限制了性能，就顺手查了些资料。
Content.LocalizedString: I've reviewed everything. I felt there was still room for speed. The parts might be limiting performance, so I did some research on the side.

Content.SourceString: 有一个匿名卖家手中有一套改装套件，性能参数不错，价格也不是问题，只是此前从未有过交易。
Content.LocalizedString: There's an anonymous seller who has a modification kit with decent performance specs, and price isn't an issue. It's just that I've never done business with them before.

Content.SourceString: 而鉴定师在拍卖会上的协助，令人印象深刻。
Content.LocalizedString: And your assistance at the auction was quite impressive.

Content.SourceString: 所以我想询问鉴定师，能否和我一同前往这个卖家的位置，确定套件的真伪？
Content.LocalizedString: So I wanted to ask you, Appraiser, if you could come with me to this seller's location to verify whether the kit is authentic?

Content.SourceString: 我的异能似乎只对异象或异能者有效，至于机车的套件，可能不太方便……
Content.LocalizedString: My Esper Ability seems to only work on anomalies or espers. As for motorcycle parts, that might not work…

Content.SourceString: 也不是什么都能鉴定……如果是异象机车或许还可以一试。
Content.LocalizedString: I can't appraise just anything… though if it were an Anomaly motorcycle, maybe I could give it a try.

Content.SourceString: 只是普通机车的话，还是不太方便……
Content.LocalizedString: If it's just an ordinary motorcycle though…

Content.SourceString: 遗憾.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: regret.jpg

Content.SourceString: 看来只能下次和鉴定师一起合作了。
Content.LocalizedString: We will work together next time.

Content.SourceString: 奋斗.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: determined.jpg

Content.SourceString: 加油.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: youcandoit.jpg

Content.SourceString: 下次一定.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: nexttimeforsure.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，我追查到那个卖家。
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, I tracked down that seller.

Content.SourceString: 的确是个职业骗子。
Content.LocalizedString: He's definitely a professional con artist.

Content.SourceString: 抓到人了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Did you catch him?

Content.SourceString: 抓到了。我还发现有人悬赏揭发他的骗局，就顺手接下。
Content.LocalizedString: I got him. I also found someone had posted a bounty for exposing his scams, so I took that job too.

Content.SourceString: 悬赏的金额不少，足以抵消「异象机车套件」的损失，还略有盈余。
Content.LocalizedString: The bounty was pretty substantial. It's enough to cover our losses from the Anomaly bike parts, with a little extra left over.

Content.SourceString: 很不错的结果啊。
Content.LocalizedString: That's a really good outcome.

Content.SourceString: 那个，你昨天说要给我的鉴定报酬……
Content.LocalizedString: Um, about the appraisal fee you mentioned yesterday…

Content.SourceString: 收到转账10000方斯
Content.LocalizedString: Incoming Transfer: 10,000 Fons

Content.SourceString: 收到转账10000方斯
Content.LocalizedString: Incoming Transfer: 10,000 Fons

Content.SourceString: 这是分成。多谢你的帮助，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Here's your share. Thank you for your help.

Content.SourceString: 差点忘了，抱歉。
Content.LocalizedString: Almost forgot, sorry about that.

Content.SourceString: 不客气。那我就收下了，谢谢你。
Content.LocalizedString: You're welcome. I'll take it then, thank you.

Content.SourceString: 没事。以后有类似需要的话，都可以来找我。
Content.LocalizedString: It's fine. If you have similar jobs in the future, feel free to come to me.

Content.SourceString: 好的。
Content.LocalizedString: I see.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，方便来一趟9℃咖啡厅吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, are you free to come around 9°C Coffee for a moment?

Content.SourceString: 有件事需要鉴定师的协助，有偿。
Content.LocalizedString: There's something that requires your assistance. It's paid work.

Content.SourceString: 什么事？
Content.LocalizedString: What is it?

Content.SourceString: 想请你鉴定一件物品，不会耽误你太久。
Content.LocalizedString: I'd like you to appraise an item. It won't take too long.

Content.SourceString: 好，那我现在过来。
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, I'll head over now.

Content.SourceString: 我在店外的位置等你，麻烦了。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll wait for you outside the shop. Thanks for coming.

Content.SourceString: 我在店外的位置等你，麻烦了。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll wait for you outside the shop. Thanks for coming.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，或许你有Rover A1吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you happen to have a Rover A1?

Content.SourceString: 有。怎么了？
Content.LocalizedString: I do. Why?

Content.SourceString: Rover A1是什么？
Content.LocalizedString: What's a Rover A1?

Content.SourceString: 一款被称作「小踏板」的代步车。
Content.LocalizedString: A personal vehicle commonly called the Scooter.

Content.SourceString: 了解，有的。
Content.LocalizedString: I see. Yes, I have one.

Content.SourceString: 我想借用一下，不知鉴定师是否方便？我在愿木坡附近的改车店。
Content.LocalizedString: I'd like to borrow it for a bit. Would that be convenient for you, Appraiser? I'm at the mod shop near Yuanmu Hill.

Content.SourceString: 可以，我现在过来。
Content.LocalizedString: Sure, I'll head over now.

Content.SourceString: 十分感谢。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you very much.

Content.SourceString: 十分感谢。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you very much.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，今晚有空一起看电影吗？我有两张《穿越，从高中部开始的网球之旅！》剧场版的电影票。
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, are you free tonight? Want to catch a movie together? I have two tickets for this… "Isekai Tennis Journey: Starting from High School! - THE MOVIE"…

Content.SourceString: 有空。怎么突然想到看电影？
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah, I'm free. What made you suddenly think of watching a movie?

Content.SourceString: 老师让我了解当代年轻人的生活，或许看电影是一个切入点……？
Content.LocalizedString: Mentor told me to learn about how young people live nowadays. Maybe watching movies could be a good starting point…?

Content.SourceString: 而且之前有劳鉴定师协助，一直没机会表达感谢。
Content.LocalizedString: Besides, you've helped me out before, and I haven't had a chance to properly thank you.

Content.SourceString: 好。在哪里见面？
Content.LocalizedString: Okay. Where should we meet?

Content.SourceString: 新赫兰德的「浮冰影院」，今晚七点，我会提前在影院楼下等你。
Content.LocalizedString: Floe Cinema, New Herland, seven tonight. I'll be waiting downstairs at the theater early.

Content.SourceString: 新赫兰德的「浮冰影院」，今晚七点，我会提前在影院楼下等你。
Content.LocalizedString: Floe Cinema, New Herland, seven tonight. I'll be waiting downstairs at the theater early.
